value.name: approaches the house
value.description: Asha walks up to the house, carrying her phone and keys in her coat pocket as she approaches the front door.
evidence: She did not check her phone; she dropped it into her coat pocket alongside the keys and crossed in front of the sedan in the drive
She went up the two concrete steps to the porch and stopped at the door

value.name: notices the chalk drawing
value.description: As she nears the house, Asha notices a chalk drawing of a family on the front walk, including a smallest figure circled in another color.
evidence: The chalk drawing on the front walk resolved as she got closer into a lopsided house with four stick figures in a row, the smallest one with a circle drawn around it in a different color

value.name: hears television inside
value.description: Standing at the door, Asha hears the television murmuring inside the house through the wood.
evidence: close enough to hear the low murmur of the television through the wood

value.name: forces herself to knock
value.description: Asha makes herself knock on the door instead of hesitating outside.
evidence: made herself lift her hand to knock rather than stand there counting the seconds she was already spending
Asha knocked three times, evenly spaced

value.name: waits after knocking
value.description: After knocking, Asha waits in the cold, resisting the urge to check her phone and keeping her expression controlled.
evidence: Through the wood she heard the television volume cut, then a pause

She kept her face the way she kept it in the elevator at the firm, mouth neither set nor soft, and pressed her palm flat against the side of her coat to stop herself from checking the phone in the pocket

value.name: notices the chalk drawing beneath her feet
value.description: While waiting, Asha looks down and sees the chalk drawing directly beneath her, with the circled figure partly erased by rain.
evidence: The chalk drawing was directly under her feet now, the small circled figure half-erased by rain

value.name: fixes attention on the porch light
value.description: Asha deliberately looks at the porch light, continuing to steady herself while waiting at the door.
evidence: she made herself look at the porch light
